note: Universal dish-image prompt. Final prompt = style + ' ' + subject + ' ' + framing. Never edit style or framing per dish; only the subject changes. See docs/design/image-style-pilot.md section 4e.
style: Hand-drawn illustration with bold, thick dark-brown ink outlines, simplified shapes with little small detail, and flat opaque gouache fills with minimal shading, clear enough to read as a small icon.
framing: One serving centered on a plain warm cream background, seen from a 45-degree angle, the food or drink taking up no more than 60% of the frame width and kept inside the central square of a 3:2 frame with generous margin all round, soft even light, no text, no people, no hands, no logos, no table or scenery.

MX.name: Mole Poblano
MX.subject: A piece of turkey on a plate covered in thick, glossy, very dark brown-black mole sauce, sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds, a small mound of red Mexican rice beside it, two folded corn tortillas at the edge.
MX.mustShow: Near-black glossy sauce, sesame seeds, meat under the sauce
MX.wrong: Reddish chili con carne; brown gravy; beans

MX.name: Tacos
MX.subject: Three small street tacos on a plate, each on two stacked soft corn tortillas, filled with red-orange marinated pork al pastor, topped with diced white onion, chopped cilantro and a small piece of pineapple, a lime wedge and a little bowl of green salsa beside them.
MX.mustShow: Soft, small, doubled corn tortillas; red-orange pork; onion and cilantro
MX.wrong: Hard yellow U-shaped shells; lettuce, shredded yellow cheese, sour cream

MX.name: Pozole
MX.subject: A deep bowl of pozole rojo, a brick-red chili broth full of large puffed white hominy kernels, irregular and burst open at the top like popcorn, not round chickpeas, with pieces of pork, topped with shredded green cabbage, thin radish slices and a pinch of dried oregano, a lime wedge and a crisp tostada beside the bowl.
MX.mustShow: Big burst white hominy in red broth; cabbage and radish on top
MX.wrong: Beans or chickpeas instead of hominy; chili con carne; noodles

MX.name: Chiles en Nogada
MX.subject: One whole roasted green poblano pepper on a plate, stuffed and completely covered in a smooth, thick, ivory-white walnut cream sauce, scattered with bright red pomegranate seeds and a few flat green parsley leaves, so the plate shows green, white and red; served plain, not battered or fried.
MX.mustShow: Whole green poblano under white sauce; red pomegranate; green parsley
MX.wrong: Battered and fried chile relleno; red tomato sauce; melted yellow cheese

MX.name: Tamales
MX.subject: Two tamales on a plate, each lying in its opened pale tan dried corn husk, showing soft pale yellow steamed corn masa, one cut open to reveal a red chili pork filling, a small bowl of red salsa beside them; the husks are opened, not eaten.
MX.mustShow: Pale corn husks opened out; soft pale yellow masa; filling visible in one
MX.wrong: Flour tortilla burrito; enchiladas in sauce; foil wrapping; husk shown as edible

MX.name: Guacamole
MX.subject: A rough grey-black volcanic stone molcajete bowl on three short legs, filled with chunky, coarsely mashed green avocado mixed with diced white onion, diced red tomato and chopped cilantro, a lime wedge and a small pile of triangular yellow corn tortilla chips beside it.
MX.mustShow: Chunky textured avocado with visible onion, tomato, cilantro; stone molcajete
MX.wrong: Smooth bright-green puree; sour cream swirl; guacamole on a burger or toast

MX.name: Elote
MX.subject: One whole grilled corn cob on a wooden stick, the yellow kernels lightly charred, coated in a thin layer of white mayonnaise, crumbled white cotija cheese and a dusting of red chili powder, lying on a small plate with a lime wedge beside it.
MX.mustShow: Whole cob on a stick; white crumbled cheese and red chili dust over yellow kernels
MX.wrong: Melted yellow cheese; plain buttered corn; kernels off the cob in a cup (that is esquites)

MX.name: Churros
MX.subject: Four long, straight golden fried churros with deep star-shaped ridges along their length, coated in cinnamon sugar, on a small plate beside a small cup of thick dark hot chocolate for dipping.
MX.mustShow: Long ridged sticks; sandy cinnamon-sugar coating; chocolate for dipping
MX.wrong: Round donuts or rings; smooth unridged sticks; icing glaze or powdered sugar only

MX.name: Horchata
MX.subject: A tall clear glass of opaque milky-white horchata over ice cubes, a light dusting of ground cinnamon on top and a cinnamon stick standing in the glass.
MX.mustShow: Opaque milky white drink over ice; cinnamon
MX.wrong: Brown chai or latte colour; hot mug; whipped cream topping

MX.name: Jamaica
MX.subject: A tall clear glass of translucent deep ruby-red hibiscus agua fresca over ice cubes, a few dried dark-red hibiscus flowers lying beside the glass.
MX.mustShow: See-through deep ruby red over ice; dried hibiscus flowers
MX.wrong: Opaque pink smoothie; hot tea in a mug; fresh pink hibiscus blossoms

MX.name: Mexican Hot Chocolate
MX.subject: A glazed terracotta clay mug of hot chocolate topped with thick light-brown froth, a carved wooden molinillo whisk resting beside it, a broken wedge of a round Mexican chocolate tablet and a cinnamon stick beside the mug.
MX.mustShow: Clay mug with froth; carved wooden molinillo; chocolate tablet wedge
MX.wrong: Whipped cream or marshmallows; white ceramic coffee mug; metal whisk

MX.name: Mezcal
MX.subject: A small, shallow round clay cup (copita) of clear mezcal, two orange slices dusted with red chili-worm salt (sal de gusano) and a small dish of that orange-red salt beside it.
MX.mustShow: Clear spirit in a shallow clay copita; orange slices with red salt
MX.wrong: Amber whisky colour; tall shot glass with lime and white salt (that reads as tequila); cocktail glass

MX.name: Tequila
MX.subject: A tall, narrow caballito shot glass of clear blanco tequila, a lime wedge and a small pile of coarse white salt beside it.
MX.mustShow: Tall narrow shot glass; clear spirit; lime and salt
MX.wrong: Margarita or cocktail glass; amber colour; bottle with a label

MX.name: Cochinita Pibil
MX.subject: A plate of shredded pork stained deep orange-red with achiote, piled on a partly unfolded dark green banana leaf, topped with a tangle of bright pink pickled red onion rings, a small bowl of orange habanero salsa and two corn tortillas beside it.
MX.mustShow: Orange-red shredded pork; banana leaf underneath; pink pickled onions on top
MX.wrong: Pale pulled pork in brown barbecue sauce; a whole roast; a taco shell

MX.name: Sopa de Lima
MX.subject: A wide bowl of clear golden chicken broth with shredded white chicken, a heap of thin crisp fried tortilla strips on top, a thin slice of green lima citrus floating in it and a few cilantro leaves.
MX.mustShow: Clear golden broth; crisp tortilla strips piled on top; a citrus slice
MX.wrong: Creamy or red soup; noodles; a bowl of lime wedges

MX.name: Tlayudas
MX.subject: One very large, thin, crisp corn tortilla lying flat on a plate, spread with dark refried black beans, covered in shredded green cabbage, strands of white quesillo cheese, slices of tomato and avocado, and strips of thin grilled dark-red tasajo beef on top.
MX.mustShow: Huge thin flat tortilla, open like a pizza; black bean layer; white string cheese; thin grilled beef strips
MX.wrong: A pizza with red tomato sauce and melted yellow cheese; a folded quesadilla; a small taco

MX.name: Mole Negro
MX.subject: A piece of chicken on a plate completely coated in thick, glossy, jet-black mole sauce, a few toasted sesame seeds on top, a small mound of white rice beside it and a folded corn tortilla at the edge.
MX.mustShow: Jet-black, not brown, glossy sauce over the chicken; sesame seeds
MX.wrong: Dark brown gravy; chocolate dessert sauce; red chili sauce

MX.name: Carne Asada
MX.subject: Thin slices of charred grilled beef with dark grill marks on a plate, a charred whole spring onion and a grilled green jalapeño beside them, a small bowl of brown charro beans, a lime wedge and a stack of pale flour tortillas at the edge.
MX.mustShow: Thin sliced beef with grill marks; soft pale flour tortillas; charred onion
MX.wrong: A thick steak; corn tortillas; a fajita skillet with peppers and onions

MX.name: Burritos
MX.subject: Two slim, tightly rolled flour tortilla burritos on a plate, each about the thickness of a wrist, one cut in half to show a single filling of shredded brown machaca beef, a small bowl of red salsa beside them.
MX.mustShow: Slim, tightly rolled, one filling visible; pale flour tortilla
MX.wrong: A fat US-style burrito stuffed with rice, lettuce, cheese and sour cream; foil wrapping; a wet burrito covered in sauce

MX.name: Birria
MX.subject: A bowl of dark red birria consomé with tender shredded meat, beside two folded corn tortilla tacos fried to a red-orange crisp, filled with shredded beef and melted white cheese, one dipped halfway into the broth, diced white onion and cilantro sprinkled on top, a lime wedge beside them.
MX.mustShow: Red-orange crisp folded tacos; a bowl of deep red broth for dipping; shredded meat
MX.wrong: Soft yellow tacos with lettuce; chili con carne; beef stew with potatoes and carrots

MX.name: Tortas Ahogadas
MX.subject: A crusty oval birote bread roll filled with shredded carnitas pork, lying in a shallow bowl and completely drowned in thin bright red-orange tomato sauce, sliced white onion rings and a lime wedge on top, a spoon resting in the bowl.
MX.mustShow: Whole sandwich submerged in thin red sauce in a bowl; crusty bread showing above the sauce; a spoon
MX.wrong: A dry sandwich on a plate; a burger; a sandwich with melted cheese

MX.name: Aguachile
MX.subject: A shallow round plate of butterflied raw pink-white shrimp fanned out in a pool of thin bright green lime and chili sauce, with thin slices of cucumber and rings of red onion over them, a few cilantro leaves and a lime wedge beside the plate.
MX.mustShow: Butterflied shrimp in a thin bright green liquid; cucumber slices; red onion rings
MX.wrong: Shrimp cocktail in a glass; cooked orange shrimp in a creamy sauce; a tossed salad

MX.name: Pescado a la Veracruzana
MX.subject: A whole white fish fillet on a plate covered in a chunky red tomato sauce with green olives, capers, sliced white onion and a few strips of pickled jalapeño, a sprig of herb on top and a small mound of white rice beside it.
MX.mustShow: Red tomato sauce with visible green olives and capers over white fish
MX.wrong: Fried fish in batter; fish with cream sauce; a fish stew in a bowl

MX.name: Tacos de Pescado
MX.subject: Two soft corn tortillas on a plate, each holding a golden beer-battered fried fish piece, topped with shredded pale green cabbage, a drizzle of white crema, diced tomato and onion, a lime wedge and a small bowl of red salsa beside them.
MX.mustShow: Golden battered fish strip in a soft corn tortilla; shredded cabbage; white crema drizzle
MX.wrong: Grilled unbattered fish; hard taco shells; shrimp instead of fish; lettuce and yellow cheese

EG.name: Koshari
EG.subject: A deep bowl of koshari: white rice, brown lentils and small pasta layered together, topped with chickpeas, a thick red tomato sauce and a tall heap of crispy golden fried onions, a small cup of garlic vinegar sauce beside the bowl.
EG.mustShow: Visible layers of rice, lentils and pasta; red tomato sauce; a big pile of crispy fried onions on top
EG.wrong: A plain rice pilaf; a pasta dish with meat; a salad

EG.name: Ful Medames
EG.subject: A shallow bowl of mashed brown fava beans glistening with olive oil, sprinkled with ground cumin and chopped parsley, a lime wedge and slices of tomato on the rim, a round of whole-wheat baladi flatbread beside it.

EG.wrong: Refried pinto beans; hummus; a bean soup with broth

EG.name: Ta'ameya
EG.subject: Several round green-centred falafel patties, crusted golden brown and coated in sesame seeds, one split to show the bright green fava interior, on a small plate with tahini sauce and pickled vegetables beside them.
EG.mustShow: Bright green interior of a split patty; sesame-crusted golden outside
EG.wrong: Beige chickpea falafel; meatballs; fritters in a pita

EG.name: Molokhia
EG.subject: A bowl of thick, glossy, deep green molokhia soup with fried garlic slices and coriander floating on top, a mound of white rice and a round of baladi bread beside it.

EG.name: Mahshi
EG.subject: A platter of stuffed vegetables: small hollowed zucchini, a green bell pepper, an eggplant and tightly rolled dark green vine leaves, all filled with herbed rice, glistening in a thin red tomato broth.

EG.wrong: Only stuffed peppers with melted cheese; cabbage rolls in cream sauce; a salad

EG.name: Fattah
EG.subject: A deep platter with layers of torn toasted flatbread and white rice soaked in a thin broth, topped with chunks of browned lamb and a bright red tomato and garlic sauce poured over, a few fried garlic slices on top.

EG.wrong: Fattoush salad; a rice pilaf; hummus with pita

EG.name: Hamam Mahshi
EG.subject: Two small whole roasted pigeons on a plate, skin burnished deep golden brown, one cut open to show a stuffing of dark green cracked wheat (freekeh) spilling out, a lemon wedge and a few sprigs of parsley beside them.

EG.name: Hawawshi
EG.subject: A round whole-wheat baladi flatbread cut into wedges, the bread crisp and browned with oil stains, each wedge thick with a filling of spiced minced beef, onion and green pepper, one wedge pulled out to show the filling, a few pickles beside it.

EG.name: Sayadeya

EG.mustShow: Golden-brown onion-tinted rice; fish on top; lime
EG.wrong: Plain white rice; a fish and chips plate; paella with seafood

EG.name: Umm Ali
EG.subject: A round shallow clay dish of golden baked pudding with torn flaky pastry pieces soaked in milk, the top blistered and browned, scattered with pistachios, almonds, raisins and shredded coconut.
EG.mustShow: Baked pudding with pastry layers visible; browned top; nuts and raisins on top

EG.name: Kebda Eskandarani
EG.subject: A crusty oblong white bread roll split open and stuffed with dark brown chopped fried liver pieces mixed with sliced green chili and onion, a few bright pickled vegetables beside it on a small plate.

EG.wrong: A hamburger; a hot dog; sliced liver on a plate with gravy

EG.name: Samak Mashwi
EG.subject: One whole grilled fish on a plate with charred grill marks and crisp skin, scored on the side, a lime wedge and a small bowl of pale tahini sauce beside it, a few slices of tomato and cucumber.
EG.mustShow: Whole grilled fish with grill marks and head on; lime; pale tahini

EG.name: Bamia
EG.subject: A bowl of small whole green okra pods and chunks of beef in a thick red tomato sauce, a few fried garlic slices and chopped coriander on top, a mound of white rice beside it.
EG.mustShow: Whole small okra pods in red tomato sauce; beef chunks; white rice
EG.wrong: Green okra fried crisp; gumbo with sausage; a salad

EG.name: Weika
EG.subject: A bowl of thick glossy dark green stew, smoother than a soup, with a few fried garlic slices on top, beside torn pieces of a large flat golden-brown rustic bread (aish shamsi).
EG.mustShow: Very thick glossy dark green stew; torn flat rustic bread beside it
EG.wrong: Spinach salad; a clear soup; okra pods visible (this is ground okra, no pods)

EG.name: Zarb
EG.subject: A large round metal tray of pit-roasted food: a pile of browned lamb pieces, whole roasted chicken quarters, charred potatoes, carrots and onions, all smoky and darkened at the edges, a few flatbreads tucked at the side.
EG.mustShow: Big metal tray; lamb and chicken together with roasted root vegetables; charred, smoky look
EG.wrong: A single steak; a stew in a bowl; a barbecue grill with grates visible

EG.name: Farasheeh
EG.subject: A stack of very thin, large, pale flatbreads with blistered brown spots, folded loosely on a plate, a small glass of amber tea with a sprig of green herb in it and a small dish of white cheese beside them.
EG.mustShow: Paper-thin pale blistered flatbread; small glass of amber tea with a green herb sprig
EG.wrong: Thick pita; naan; a tortilla with filling

EG.name: Feteer Meshaltet
EG.subject: A round golden baked pastry cut into wedges, its edge showing dozens of thin flaky buttery layers, one wedge lifted, a small dish of honey and a wedge of white cheese beside it.
EG.mustShow: Round pastry with visible paper-thin layers at the cut edge; golden; honey and white cheese
EG.wrong: A croissant; a pizza; a pie with filling

EG.name: Kofta
EG.subject: Three long skewers of charred grilled minced meat, each oblong and ridged with grill marks, resting on a plate with a round baladi flatbread, a small bowl of pale tahini, sliced tomato, onion and parsley.
EG.mustShow: Long ridged minced-meat skewers with char; flatbread; tahini
EG.wrong: Round meatballs in sauce; cubed meat skewers; a burger

EG.name: Macarona Béchamel
EG.subject: A square slab of baked pasta on a plate, cut to show a layer of penne pasta, a dark brown layer of spiced minced beef in the middle and a thick creamy white béchamel top baked golden brown.
EG.mustShow: Square cut slab; visible layers of pasta, minced beef and white béchamel; browned top
EG.wrong: Lasagna with red sauce and melted cheese; macaroni and cheese; spaghetti

CN.name: Mapo Doufu
CN.subject: A shallow bowl of soft white tofu cubes in a glossy bright red chili oil sauce flecked with brown minced pork and fermented bean paste, chopped green scallion and a dusting of brown ground Sichuan peppercorn on top, a small bowl of white rice beside it.
CN.mustShow: Red glossy sauce; soft white tofu cubes; minced pork; scallion on top
CN.wrong: Fried crispy tofu; a brown soy stir-fry; a soup

CN.name: Beijing Kaoya

CN.name: Xiaolongbao

CN.wrong: Pan-fried potstickers; large buns; wontons in soup

CN.name: Gongbao Jiding

CN.name: Jiaozi

CN.name: Char Siu

CN.name: Hongshao Rou

CN.name: Wonton Noodle Soup

CN.name: Har Gow

CN.mustShow: Translucent pleated half-moon dumplings; pink shrimp showing through; bamboo basket

CN.name: Chuanr
CN.subject: Five long thin metal skewers of charred grilled lamb cubes with pieces of browned fat between them, dusted thickly with golden-brown cumin seeds and red chili flakes, lying in a row on a plate.

CN.name: Dapanji

CN.name: Sichuan Hot Pot
